pseudo_policy: one complete scalar-relativistic SSSP PBE Precision release; verify every SHA-256
global_cutoff_policy: maximum recommended ecutwfc and ecutrho across the union of elements in the full queue
spin_policy: initial non-spin-polarized screen; explicitly test spin polarization for surviving finalists
soc_policy: scalar-relativistic first pass; assess spin-orbit effects for Ta/W finalists before publication-quality ranking

resource_policy.note: Do not run all five jobs concurrently on the 8 GB Mac. Prefer an HPC node for production calculations.
